event_properties.content: Which platform has my worst ratings?

**Swiggy** has your lowest average at 3.6 ★. The primary drivers are delivery time complaints and packaging issues — both of which are delivery-specific problems. Your restaurant ratings (Google, Dineout) are significantly higher at 4.0+.
What do customers say about our packaging?

Packaging gets mentioned in **31 reviews** this month. 22 are positive — customers like the eco-friendly boxes. 9 are negative — mostly that the biryani container leaks during delivery. Worth flagging to your packaging vendor.
Which menu items are highest in negative feedback?

🍽️ **No Dish-Level Data Available**
I don't have specific menu item ratings in the data provided — only outlet and platform performance metrics.

🔍 **What I Can See Instead**
Across all feedback, customers flagged **Food Quality** most often (25 mentions), followed by **Service** issues (15 mentions). Common themes included stale buns, watery sauces, inconsistent pasta, and items not matching descriptions.

✅ **Recommended Next Step**
Run a dish-level analysis by tagging reviews to specific items like Bun Maska, Pasta, and Sandwiches — this will pinpoint exactly which dishes need recipe or prep fixes.
Which outlet has the most food quality complaints?

**The Tea Toast Co. - TA** has the most food quality complaints with 9 mentions. Customers frequently noticed issues like stale bread, inconsistent pasta quality, and portions that didn't match the price — suggesting a need to review ingredient freshness and prep standards at this location.
What are customers saying about service at The Tea Toast Co. - TA?

⚠️ **Service at The Tea Toast Co. - TA**
This outlet has a 2.8 rating with 51% negative feedback · Service issues appear in 7 out of 37 reviews

🔴 **What Customers Are Experiencing**
Guests frequently mentioned rude or unprofessional staff behavior, particularly at the counter. One diner described being accused of misbehaving when raising a quality concern, while others felt judged or dismissed. Slow service and attitude problems were recurring themes that left customers feeling unwelcome.

✅ **Immediate Action Needed**
Conduct a customer service training session at **The Tea Toast Co. - TA** focused on conflict resolution and respectful communication. Consider mystery shopper visits to identify specific staff interactions that need improvement.

📉 **Ratings in Freefall**
Your average rating has dropped from 4.1 to 1.0 over the past month — three consecutive weeks of decline. Right now, only about 2 in 3 customers are leaving positive feedback overall.

⚠️ **Three Critical Problems Surfacing**
Customers are frustrated by unprofessional service (especially late deliveries and poor communication at **Alipore**), inconsistent food quality (stale products, frozen items, rock-hard cakes), and portion sizes that feel unfairly small for the price. Many guests felt let down by basics like timely delivery and product freshness.

✅ **Immediate Action Needed**
Prioritize **Alipore** — audit delivery workflows and staff communication protocols today. Check inventory rotation across all outlets to catch stale stock before it ships, and review portion standards on **Zomato** where value complaints are highest.
